name: Simple Letter

angles.text: At Northshire Abbey, Llane Beshere trains warriors. The letter calls newly arrived fighters to begin martial training.
As a human, you receive your first guidance at Northshire Abbey before setting out into Elwynn Forest.
As an Alliance recruit, you are called to aid troubled residents beyond the Silver Hand's shelter at Northshire Abbey.

faq.answer: Warriors returning from the kobold camps receive the Simple Letter in Northshire Valley. It sends them to Llane Beshere, the local trainer, to begin martial instruction.
Llane Beshere trains warriors at Northshire Abbey. He teaches novices combat and welcomes recruits sent to him with orders or recommendations.

aliases: where to turn in simple letter
faq.answer: Bring the letter to Llane Beshere at Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley. The holy order protects the abbey grounds.
faq.q: Where do I deliver the Simple Letter?

aliases: what are paladins doing in northshire
faq.answer: The Knights of the Silver Hand guard Northshire Valley. Their protection keeps the abbey and its immediate grounds relatively secure while recruits, farmers, and clergy carry on amid growing local tensions.
faq.q: What role do the Knights of the Silver Hand play in Northshire?

aliases: why does beshere want me to help citizens
faq.answer: Local residents face encroachments and shortages, though the abbey itself is fairly well defended. Llane Beshere urges new arrivals to explore the surrounding land and lend strength to those in need.
faq.q: Why are the local citizens in need of assistance?

aliases: when should i return to llane beshere
faq.answer: Llane Beshere is at the abbey day and night, training warriors as they gain combat experience and need more advanced martial skills.
faq.q: When should I return to Llane Beshere after delivering the letter?

sections.body: New warriors arriving in Northshire Valley are directed by letter to Llane Beshere, the trainer at Northshire Abbey. They are to meet their instructor and learn the lay of the surrounding land. Then they can prepare for the demands of martial life.
sections.title: A Call to Arms

sections.body: The Knights of the Silver Hand guard Northshire Abbey, yet trouble reaches people beyond its protection. Llane Beshere tells new warriors that valley residents need able protectors. He urges them to master their weapons and defend those who live there.
sections.title: Securing the Valley

summary: At Northshire Abbey, new warriors are sent to Llane Beshere for training. Their letter calls them to aid the valley's troubled residents.
